### 2026-10-08 – Trace her? But I hardly know her!

**3h**

Trace her? But I hardly know her!
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/uLIqMAXowmqNgcuNMGbmqRDncVwyXbTk/6695ecbccd2cb9b978e4ef324c5111793def2f9a75bf38843799dcbe2585817a.png)
^^The pcb without the edges is around 61mm x 51mm
Today I wanted to do all of the traces, but I severely underestimated the time requirements of doing so. When I started I thought that this task would take about an hour or so, and thus I was not expecting to dump 3 hours into it. To be fair I am just learning though, although I hope I do get faster...
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/uLIqMAXowmqNgcuNMGbmqRDncVwyXbTk/004f74dc492e47aa6425530266a8bbc97da9ea9f43eb900404c7e03c26decce5.png)
I am yet to put the big ground and +3v3 copper areas (IDK what they are called) down, but otherwise I think the board is looking really nice. I am really proud of how compact I made it, at the cost of hours of my day. In the future I would almost certainly go with the already made pico 2, but making this was a vital experience in terms of how those boards actually work.
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/uLIqMAXowmqNgcuNMGbmqRDncVwyXbTk/1f9f5089a48166713c43e4dce862b75c4453ae6b281e46be591216606a62342a.png)
Understandably, DRC is throwing a hissy fit, although most, if not all, of those errors will be resolved by putting in the area thingies (still don't know what they are called).
TLDR: Did 90% of the PCB, and severely underestimated time costs...

### 2026-10-11 – Final session!

**4h**

Final session!

So yesterday (I am writing this the day after because I didn't have the energy to record a reel yesterday) I decided that I was going to lock in and get this complete. So, with the power of ADHD hyperfocus, I completed a large amount of work.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/uLIqMAXowmqNgcuNMGbmqRDncVwyXbTk/3b40797af2b1f3ec72cd7e06801ff04362da02302126f2a2414af31c9afee15c.png)
As you can see, I decided to (later regretting the following decision) use illustrator to design the silkscreen art. It is nothing special, but it does feature that weird blob cat thingy, which I like. I am proud of it, and the font I chose is kinda interesting.
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/uLIqMAXowmqNgcuNMGbmqRDncVwyXbTk/21fe1d7b91544bf163c4e704864a7ba309028810fe9bfb3c58b94f45ab3cd99e.png)
^^Good luck reading this word :)
It looked OK after I added it to the PCB, and the elements I designed fit well onto the empty spaces on the board.
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/uLIqMAXowmqNgcuNMGbmqRDncVwyXbTk/b51241652699530e3af03957a316376f76b9b0b341c3ff687af30bdd32ac6f59.png)
I did follow a tutorial to get it to export from illustrator in the right format and subsequently upload it to KiCAD, but I think it was worth the effort to do so!

After all of that, I wanted a nice render of the board, so I used blender to do so. I went from this pretty bad looking one from KiCAD's built in renderer to a nice looking render after a little bit of effort.
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/uLIqMAXowmqNgcuNMGbmqRDncVwyXbTk/19a3869edf8e19762192848e0d0ad57d27145753dff859acc943b01253ba80a7.png)
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/uLIqMAXowmqNgcuNMGbmqRDncVwyXbTk/014f53f59fd332bf92c2a14358cc86670e6282d90a8773852e09906fde10b983.png)

To get the render, I had to go through a few steps. First, I had to export the board as a GLB file from KiCAD and then move it over to blender (pretty simple). Then I placed down a solid mesh to serve as the floor, then set up 2 lights to point at the PCB from different angles and with different brightnesses. I originally had them way to bright, leading to the board looking whitewashed, but after I turned them down they looked a lot better. Finally, I had to set up the camera angle so that I could get the right kind of shot.
![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/uLIqMAXowmqNgcuNMGbmqRDncVwyXbTk/ead3156bca9799f88516a9f2d8e3a238a2acf43a4e319c705d17d1cf24530523.png)

All in all, I am really proud of the work that I put into this project, and the skills I learnt with KiCAD and blender are going to be really valuable in the future. I think that the end result, while slightly less than I imagined, feels like an achievement, and I think that getting to put this together will be really fun.
